resources.string: You can request deletion of live complaint content linked to this app installation.
Checking this installation’s local complaint state…
No local complaint identity or retained operations were found. This does not confirm server deletion.
Local complaint cleanup needs attention. Use the local recovery actions below, then check local status again. This does not confirm server deletion.
The deletion state is uncertain. A request may already have been sent. Check local status before taking another action.
The deletion request or its local cleanup is still pending. Completion is not confirmed. Continue the existing request; do not create a replacement.
The server deletion request completed. This installation’s local complaint identity and retained operations were cleared.

This requests deletion of live complaint content linked to this installation on the server. Completion also clears the local complaint identity and retained operations. You may lose access to complaint history. Server deletion cannot be undone. Backups may retain copies until they expire. Some content-free identifier and deletion records remain permanently to prevent deleted content from being restored or identifiers from being reused.
A request accepted by the server may continue after you close this dialog or the app.
Uninstalling the app does not delete complaint data on the server.
Local recovery or abandonment does not erase server data, confirm server deletion, or undo a request already sent.
Server-suggested wait: %1$d s. Continue manually; there is no automatic retry.
The last attempt could not finish. The same deletion request is still retained.
